task: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the tomato sauce bottle.
Approach the tomato sauce bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the tomato sauce bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the blue can from above, lowering the open gripper toward its top.
Grasp the tomato sauce bottle by closing the gripper fingers around its body.
Release the gripper and retract it upward from above the blue can.
Release the tomato sauce onto the table beside the milk carton and open the gripper.
Grasp the blue can from above, closing the gripper fingers around its sides.
Lift the blue can up off the table, raising it above the milk carton.
Lift the tomato sauce can up off the table, raising it above the milk carton.
Carry the alphabet soup can horizontally across the table toward the basket.
Carry the alphabet soup can horizontally toward the basket.
